segments.thag16.1:1.1: “Yaññatthaṃ vā dhanatthaṃ vā, ye hanāma mayaṃ pure;
segments.thag16.1:1.3: Avasesaṃ [avase taṃ (sī. aṭṭha. mūlapāṭho), avasesānaṃ (aṭṭha.?)] bhayaṃ hoti, vedhanti vilapanti ca.
segments.thag16.1:2.1: “Tassa te natthi bhītattaṃ, bhiyyo vaṇṇo pasīdati;
segments.thag16.1:4.3: Na bhayaṃ maraṇe hoti, bhāranikkhepane yathā.
segments.thag16.1:5.3: Maraṇe me bhayaṃ natthi, rogānamiva saṅkhaye.
segments.thag16.1:6.3: Nirassādā bhavā diṭṭhā, visaṃ pitvāva [pītvāva (sī.)] chaḍḍitaṃ.
segments.thag16.1:7.3: Tuṭṭho āyukkhayā hoti, mutto āghātanā yathā.
segments.thag16.1:8.3: Ādittāva gharā mutto, maraṇasmiṃ na socati.
segments.thag16.1:9.1: “Yadatthi saṅgataṃ kiñci, bhavo vā yattha labbhati;
segments.thag16.1:9.3: Sabbaṃ anissaraṃ etaṃ, iti vuttaṃ mahesinā.
segments.thag16.1:10.1: “Yo taṃ tathā pajānāti, yathā buddhena desitaṃ;
segments.thag16.1:10.3: Na gaṇhāti bhavaṃ kiñci, sutattaṃva ayoguḷaṃ.
segments.thag16.1:12.3: Passantassa yathābhūtaṃ, na bhayaṃ hoti gāmaṇi.
segments.thag16.1:13.3: Mamattaṃ so asaṃvindaṃ,‘natthi me’ti na socati.
segments.thag16.1:14.3: Soyaṃ bhijjissati kāyo, añño ca na bhavissati.
segments.thag16.1:15.1: “Yaṃ vo kiccaṃ sarīrena, taṃ karotha yadicchatha;
segments.thag16.1:15.3: Na me tappaccayā tattha, doso pemañca hehiti”.
segments.thag16.1:16.1: Tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā, abbhutaṃ lomahaṃsanaṃ;
segments.thag16.1:17.1: “Kiṃ bhadante karitvāna, ko vā ācariyo tava;
segments.thag16.1:20.1: Sutvāna corā isino subhāsitaṃ, nikkhippa satthāni ca āvudhāni ca;
segments.thag16.1:20.3: Tamhā ca kammā viramiṃsu eke, eke ca pabbajjamarocayiṃsu.
segments.thag16.1:21.1: Te pabbajitvā sugatassa sāsane, bhāvetva bojjhaṅgabalāni paṇḍitā;
segments.thag16.1:21.3: Udaggacittā sumanā katindriyā, phusiṃsu nibbānapadaṃ asaṅkhatanti.
